remediationSummary: The five Bun production artifacts (API, web, worker, migration runner, operations CLI) were rebuilt after pinning final Alpine runtime zlib to 1.3.2-r1. The prior CVE-2026-85091 medium finding from installed zlib 1.3.2-r0 is absent from all five exact final local images; each now has zero findings at all severities.
PostgreSQL base high/critical findings came from bundled gosu built with Go 1.24.6; the production Dockerfile replaces it with a Go 1.26.9 build. Current final artifact has zero critical/high.
Caddy base high findings came from bundled Go 1.26.8 and x/net 0.59.0; the production Dockerfile builds Caddy 2.11.7 with Go 1.26.9 and x/net 0.60.0. Current final artifact has zero critical/high.

SeaweedFS 4.48 source commit 530be3e37337488ecc34d58441e0bc476e121c93 is rebuilt with Go 1.26.9 and golang.org/x/net 0.60.0. The exact local linux/amd64 candidate has zero critical/high; the official upstream image scan has three high Go advisories. The patched artifact still lacks a verified registry digest because publication was denied.

The patched local Prometheus 3.15.0 candidate was rebuilt with Go 1.26.9 and x/net 0.60.0 and rescanned with zero critical/high; the official upstream baseline has three high Go IDs. The local candidate still needs registry publication and an immutable manifest digest.
OTel 0.163.1 and Mailpit 1.31.6 remove their earlier high Go stdlib/x/net findings. Their exact scans retain one UNKNOWN GO-2026-5932 finding in x/crypto v0.58.0 each; no critical/high remains.

The local Authentik 2026.8.4 candidate updates OpenSSL, urllib3, Python setuptools/msgpack layers, and removes stale global pip tooling. It reduces the official base findings but retains one critical and 15 high Debian Trixie OS-package IDs; installed versions equal repository candidates and Trivy reports no fixes for these current residuals.

Grafana 13.2.4 retains 12 high Go dependency IDs; fixed dependency versions are reported, but candidate upstream tags 13.2.5 and 13.3.0 were not present at direct registry recheck. Its supported Ubuntu image variant retained the same findings.

The OSRM v26.10.0 candidate now uses the pinned official routing binary in a pinned Distroless Debian 13 C++ runtime. The exact linux/amd64 local final artifact scans at zero critical/high, down from eight high Debian OS-package IDs in the prior full Debian runtime. The final image retains 23 medium and 8 low findings; its custom GHCR digest is still unavailable until publication.
